definitionZh: 延迟将拖动手势延迟指定的毫秒数。如果您不希望立即触发逻辑，这可能很有用。下面的示例将延迟设置为 1000。尝试单击正方形而不移动鼠标。
sourceDefinition: delay delays the drag gesture for the amount of milliseconds you specify. This might be useful if you don't want your logic to fire right away. The below example has a delay set to 1000. Try clicking on the square without moving your mouse.
